Grand Hotel 03 · Hospitality · 2025

Somewhere you disappear to.

Frame pending
Client
Grand Hotel 03
Category
Hospitality
Year
2025
Commission
Concept Commission

The objective

Occupancy is healthy. Cultural presence is not.

A property with genuine architectural significance and a booking funnel doing its job — but no standing in the culture, and therefore no pricing power beyond the season.

The objective was reputation, measured over years rather than quarters.

What we heard

The building has better stories than the brand does.

The commercial team had files of them: who stayed, what was written there, which suite was closed for a decade and why.

Hospitality marketing had been flattening all of that into amenity photography.

The opportunity

Publish the building, not the offer.

Hotels that hold cultural weight do so because they are associated with work — books written, films cut, deals made.

That association can be built deliberately, if the brand is willing to spend on culture rather than on reach.

The idea

A house that keeps what happens inside it.

The property positions itself as a keeper of work rather than a seller of nights.

Every expression is a record of something that happened there, which gives the brand an editorial engine instead of a campaign calendar.

The world

Architectural stillness, human traces, no guests in frame.

Static compositions, natural light, long holds. Rooms are photographed after someone has left them.

Sound design carries the building: lifts, service doors, the particular acoustics of a stairwell.

The system

One story, expressed across every surface.

  • Brand film
  • Room-by-room editorial series
  • Residency and commission programme identity
  • Print annual
  • Owned channel formats
  • Seasonal adaptation

The outcome

Developed as a creative proposition.

Grand Hotel 03 is a Concept Commission. It was developed by the studio to demonstrate an approach to cultural positioning in hospitality and was not produced for a client.
